🏎️ Every Formula 1 constructors' title — 1958 → 2025.

Ferrari has 16, nobody else more than 10. But that total is built on longevity: Ferrari is the only team to have raced every season. Watch the eras instead — Lotus in the sixties, Ferrari's run from 1999, then Mercedes stacking eight straight titles from 2014 🏁

📊 Data: F1DB (CC BY 4.0). Flags show each team's racing licence nationality.
